title: Loading and error boundaries: Use loading.tsx for Suspense fallback, error.tsx as a client-rendered boundary, and explicit accessible status/error content
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for loading and error boundaries. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: Use loading.tsx for Suspense fallback, error.tsx as a client-rendered boundary, and explicit accessible status/error content.
Repair the intentionally failing next-loading-error-boundaries model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain loading and error boundaries in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.04 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.
